prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: I was reminiscing about that Shanghai trip back in 2025—someone in our group kept joking about how we basically lived off restaurant-hopping.
One lunch that stuck with me was at a place called Chuanfu Laozao; I remember it because the name sounded so dramatic.
It was on 2025-03-17, and we squeezed in at 11:30—pretty sure it was a table for 6, so it felt like a mini reunion.
Liu Yang handled the reservation details at the time; I still have the contact saved as 13845935572, which is kind of funny now.
Then later that year we were in Beijing and everyone was talking about shows nonstop—felt like there was something happening every night.
My friend Zhou Jun had already bought tickets for the Jay Chou Concert—2 seats in Stand B—and the receipt had his phone as 13877005685.
